annotation.title_clean: New ETSI standard protects AI systems from evolving cyber threats
annotation.title_en: New ETSI standard protects AI systems from evolving cyber threats
named_instruments_referenced: NCSC Guidelines for Secure AI System Development
UK AI Cyber Security Code of Practice
ETSI TS Baseline Cyber Security Requirements for AI Models and Systems
annotation.summary_en: NCSC blog announcing ETSI's publication of a technical specification and report on baseline cyber security requirements for AI models and systems, developed with UK DSIT. It sets 13 principles across five lifecycle stages, and the UK will align its AI Cyber Security Code of Practice with it.
key_provisions_or_claims: ETSI specification is described as the first global standard with minimum AI security requirements across the full lifecycle
13 core security principles across five lifecycle stages: design, development, deployment, maintenance, end of life
Accompanying technical report supports implementation, with mappings to international frameworks
UK will update its Code of Practice and Implementation Guide to mirror the ETSI documents
Next step is progressing towards a European standard
